title: Scorpious187's Token Movement
description: Makes moving a token feel like moving a miniature. Tokens lift, hop from space to space and land with a footstep; while you drag, the spaces you can reach are painted on the grid, with a second band for a dash. System-agnostic: speeds are read from a configurable actor data path, with presets for common systems. Built on Foundry v14's own movement, pathfinding and ruler rather than replacing them.
